blocks.heading: Match and complete
paragraphs: Use a word from the box to finish each sentence. Each word is used once.

items.q: A ______ turns sunlight into power for a house.
My torch stopped working because the ______ was flat.
Cars burn ______ to make them move.
On the hill there is a tall ______ that spins in the wind.
We use ______ to light our classroom.

questions.title: Choose the best ending
questions.instructions: Tick one box for each sentence.

tiers.task: Write three sentences about how your family uses energy.
Write a paragraph with three ways to save energy at home and why each one helps.
Compare two kinds of energy. Which is better for your city, and why?

items.q: Draw your home and label two places where you could save energy.
